title: UV-Vis Spectrophotometer Quartz Cuvette Scratch Inspection
description: Intermediate chemical synthesis and analytical module analyzing uv-vis spectrophotometer quartz cuvette scratch inspection.
learning_objectives: Master professional Adverbial Clauses of Contrast in organic API synthesis and QC analysis
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in uv-vis spectrophotometer quartz cuvette scratch inspection
Demonstrate precision in HPLC, Karl Fischer, and pharmacopeial compliance documentation

questions.prompt: All volumetric glassware _____ with high-purity solvent prior to analytical trace analysis.

explanations.correct: Passive construction with modal: 'must be rinsed'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modal 'must' takes bare infinitive.
explanations.wrong_C: 'must rinse' is active voice; glassware does not rinse itself.
explanations.wrong_D: 'are must' is completely ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Analytical chemistry SOPs strictly require passive voice with modals: 'must be rinsed' (musí být vypláchnuto).
